note: Set A contains misbound claims where beam labels (B1) are incorrectly associated with different grid locations (Grid 5, Grid 3) or quotes that describe other beams, making those claims factually wrong. Set B is factually accurate regarding the openings and radius but misses section properties and contains duplicate claims for the same openings. Set B is preferred for having no incorrect claims, adhering to the preference for fewer wrong claims over more claims.
remarks: Both sets extract the same opening facts multiple times (e.g., D5 hole extracted twice in both sets). Set A's attempt to capture section properties introduces binding errors between grid locations and beam marks.
